product.description: Great Value Tomato Sauce is seasoned with a flavorful blend of tomatoes, onions, garlic, sweet bell peppers and other tasty ingredients. This tomato sauce is great for a variety of recipes including pasta sauce, chili, soups, stews, casseroles, pizza, meatloaf, enchiladas, salsas and more. Enjoy fresh from the farm taste with Great Value Tomato Sauce. Great Value Canned Tomatoes. Grown by Family Farmers. Our story starts in California's Central Valley, where local family farmers work diligently to bring the wholesome goodness of Great Value canned tomatoes to your home. Ripe tomatoes are picked and canned at the peak of freshness within 5 hours of harvest. The tomatoes are steam peeled to preserve freshness and flavor. Great Value canned tomatoes are available in many different varieties and styles. We hope you enjoy this eating experience with your families for years to come.
